description: Java class PgCaMigrator for migrating time series data from a source file into Cassandra SSTables, handling partitioning, data type casting, and processing of latest and timestamped data blocks.

classes.name: PgCaMigrator
classes.description: Main class responsible for migrating data from a source file into Cassandra SSTables, with methods for processing blocks, casting data types, and managing writers.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration process, reading the source file, processing data blocks, and writing to SSTables.

methods.name: logLinesProcessed
methods.description: Logs the number of lines processed at batch intervals.

methods.name: logLinesMigrated
methods.description: Logs the number of lines migrated at batch intervals.

methods.name: addTypeIdKey
methods.description: Adds entity type, UUID, and key ID to the result list based on raw data.

methods.name: addPartitions
methods.description: Calculates and adds partition information based on timestamp.

methods.name: addTimeseries
methods.description: Adds timeseries timestamp to the result list.

methods.name: addValues
methods.description: Adds various value fields to the result list, handling nulls and data conversions.

methods.name: toValuesTs
methods.description: Converts raw line data into structured values for timestamped data.

methods.name: toValuesLatest
methods.description: Converts raw line data into structured values for latest data.

methods.name: toPartitionTs
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a partition timestamp truncated to the start of the month.

methods.name: processPartitions
methods.description: Stores partition keys for later processing.

methods.name: processBlock
methods.description: Processes a block of lines, converting and writing data, handling writer lifecycle.

methods.name: castToNumericIfPossible
methods.description: Attempts to cast a value to a number if possible, updating the data structure accordingly.

methods.name: isBlockFinished
methods.description: Determines if a data block has ended based on line content.

methods.name: isBlockTsStarted
methods.description: Checks if a line indicates the start of a timestamped data block.

methods.name: isBlockLatestStarted
methods.description: Checks if a line indicates the start of a latest data block.
